shortDescription: Creates a resource of Ecs/Instance in Huawei Cloud

options.name: access_key
options.description: Specifies the access key of the HuaweiCloud to use.

options.name: admin_pass
options.description: Specifies the initial login password of the administrator account for logging in to an ECS using password authentication. The Linux administrator is root, and the Windows administrator is Administrator. Password complexity requirements, consists of 8 to 26 characters. The password must contain at least three of the following character types "uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters (!@$%^-_=+[{}]:,./?)". The password cannot contain the username or the username in reve

options.name: availability_zone
options.description: Specifies the name of the AZ where the ECS is located.

options.name: cloud
options.description: Specifies the endpoint of the cloud. Required if you are using other cloud supported by Huaweicloud.

options.name: data_volumes
options.description: Specifies the data disks of ECS instance.

options.name: description
options.description: Specifies the description of an ECS, which is a null string by default. Can contain a maximum of 85 characters. Cannot contain special characters, such as < and >.

options.name: eip_id
options.description: Specifies the ID of the elastic IP address assigned to the ECS. Only elastic IP addresses in the DOWN state can be assigned.

options.name: enterprise_project_id
options.description: Specifies the ID of the enterprise project to which the ECS belongs.

options.name: filters
options.description: A list of filters to apply when deciding whether existing resources match and should be altered. The item of filters is the name of input options.

options.name: flavor_name
options.description: Specifies the name of the system flavor.

options.name: identity_endpoint
options.description: Specifies the Identity authentication URL. Required if you are using other cloud supported by Huaweicloud.

options.name: image_id
options.description: Specifies the ID of the system image.

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the ECS name. Value requirements: Consists of 1 to 64 characters, including letters, digits, underscores C(_), hyphens (-), periods (.).

options.name: nics
options.description: Specifies the NIC information of the ECS. Constraints the network of the NIC must belong to the VPC specified by vpc_id. A maximum of 12 NICs can be attached to an ECS.

options.name: project_id
options.description: Specifies the of ID of the project to login with.

options.name: region
options.description: Specifies the Huawei Cloud region.

options.name: root_volume
options.description: Specifies the configuration of the ECS's system disks.

options.name: secret_key
options.description: Specifies the secret key of the HuaweiCloud to use.

options.name: security_groups
options.description: Specifies the security groups of the ECS. If this parameter is left blank, the default security group is bound to the ECS by default.

options.name: server_metadata
options.description: Specifies the metadata of ECS to be created.

options.name: server_tags
options.description: Specifies the tags of an ECS. When you create ECSs, one ECS supports up to 10 tags.

options.name: ssh_key_name
options.description: Specifies the name of the SSH key used for logging in to the ECS.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the given object should exist in Huawei Cloud.

options.name: timeouts
options.description: The timeouts for each operations.

options.name: user_data
options.description: Specifies the user data to be injected during the ECS creation process. Text, text files, and gzip files can be injected. The content to be injected must be encoded with base64. The maximum size of the content to be injected (before encoding) is 32 KB. For Linux ECSs, this parameter does not take effect when adminPass is used. Examples are provided as follows 'Linux #! /bin/bash echo user_test >> /home/user.txt Windows rem cmd echo 111 > c:aa.tx.'

options.name: vpc_id
options.description: Specifies the ID of the VPC to which the ECS belongs.
